payments fail but error rate dashboard green no 5xx silent failures

events.statement: payment-service logs show mTLS handshake rejections with bank-partner-api beginning 2026-04-02T12:15:27Z.
The client certificate used by payment-service to call bank-partner-api expired at 2026-04-02T12:15:00Z, causing TLS alert 45 (certificate expired).
payment-service bank_api_error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to 100% in the 12:12-12:20 buckets and stayed 100% through 13:56.
payment-service payment_success_rate collapsed from ~99% to ~2-3% in the 12:12-12:20 buckets and remained ~2-3% through 13:56.
payment-service HTTP error_rate remained flat ~0.2% across the entire window (11:00-13:56), explaining the green dashboard.
Failed payments are recorded as PENDING_RETRY rather than surfaced as HTTP 5xx, so the HTTP error-rate panel does not reflect them.
payment-service request_rate was stable ~100 req/s and latency_p99 DROPPED from ~320ms to ~140ms at onset (no load or saturation spike).
The only config change in window was payment-service bank.api.timeout_ms 3000->5000 at 2026-04-02T11:20:00Z, ~55 min before onset.
The only deployment in window was settlement-service v1.9.0 (CSV exporter) at 2026-04-02T10:30:00Z; no payment-service deployment occurred.
A prior incident HIST-106 (settlement-service, 2025-06-30) had the same pattern: client certificate expired, no renewal automation.
settlement-service logs show only benign GC pauses and one NTP clock resync; no payment-affecting errors.
